inputs.label: Tomb Raider I (1996)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of the original Tomb Raider I from Steam or GOG.

steps.why: The first launch creates the BeefRaiderXR folders.

notes: Uncertain: the guide only says to copy the game data files into /sdcard/BeefRaiderXR/. The GOG copy is identified by GAME.GOG or TOMB.DAT, which suggests a disc image whose files may need extracting first; if so this is guided. The data/LEVEL1.PHD layout comes from the payload. Steam app ID 224960 is from memory. The guide installs from SideQuest; the GitHub release also has a Pico APK and a .7z.
